request.operator_instruction: This uses the documented Extractions API ... Install zod and tsx, set OPENROUTER_API_KEY, then run npx tsx extract.ts document.txt
request.objective: Execute the pasted script unmodified against one real 60k-char lease and record, from the response itself, whether model scaledown/extract on POST /api/alpha/extractions returns a usable span for each answer.
acceptance_criteria: The pasted script runs unmodified against extract-test/docs/legal-property/01-property-lease.txt
Every per-window HTTP status and the count of answers with and without span is recorded
The raw response body of at least one window is preserved as evidence
Whether any field reaches matches[] versus review[] is reported from observed output only

authorization.scope: One run of extract-as-pasted.ts over one lease; one zod install without saving; read-only inspection of existing outputs

workspace.verifier_worktree: not provisioned (measurement task, no code change)

allowed_commands.purpose: Provide the import the pasted script requires, without touching package.json or the lockfile
Execute the pasted pipeline against one real lease

stop_conditions: The route returns 4xx for the documented body shape
